verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single line saying Highnote can create "tokenized digital cards" (highnote-docs-1). That implies some network tokenization but never names Apple Pay or Google Pay, and nothing in the pack shows wallet provisioning actually working. missing for 10: Apple Pay/Google Pay push provisioning from an app, documented entitlements process, in-wallet card art configuration, manual provisioning fallback, mobile SDK for wallet provisioning, independent corroboration.
